steps: Press the TEST button on each GFCI outlet or breaker - power should cut off.
Press RESET to restore power and confirm it comes back on.
For AFCI breakers at the panel, use the built-in test button the same way.
If a device won't reset or trips constantly, that indicates a wiring fault - call an electrician.
Note any dead outlets after testing so you can restore/investigate them.
